name: claude-checkpoint-mcp
description: MCP server that checkpoints Claude Code session context to survive crashes and token limits

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.js && chmod +x dist/index.js && mkdir -p plugin/dist && cp dist/index.js plugin/dist/index.js
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
